---
title: "Blood products — data and imputation"
format: html
---

- Counts and exposure cover the first 182 days; exposure ends at death or censoring.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(mice)
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "07-blood-products", "results")
imputation_path <- file.path(results_dir, "imputation.rds")
completed_path <- file.path(results_dir, "completed-datasets.rds")

dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Data

```{r}
#| label: blood-data

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)

blood_data <- cohort |>
  mutate(
    # Rebuilt: the export leaves the combined count empty when none were given.
    n_blood_products = n_erythrocyte_concentrates + n_thrombocyte_concentrates,
    exposure_days = survival_time_days,
    ecog_group = case_when(
      ecog_fstcnt <= 1 ~ "0-1",
      ecog_fstcnt == 2 ~ "2",
      ecog_fstcnt >= 3 ~ "3+"
    ),
    ecog_group = factor(
      ecog_group,
      levels = c("0-1", "2", "3+"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    id,
    tx,
    n_blood_products,
    n_erythrocyte_concentrates,
    n_thrombocyte_concentrates,
    exposure_days,
    age,
    hemoglobin,
    platelet_count,
    creatinine,
    ecog_group
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(blood_data$n_blood_products))
```

```{r}
#| label: exclude-zero-exposure

n_zero_exposure <- sum(blood_data$exposure_days == 0)

# Zero follow-up means no time at risk, so no rate: excluded.
blood_data <- blood_data |>
  filter(exposure_days > 0)

write_parquet(
  blood_data,
  file.path(results_dir, "analysis-data.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

n_zero_exposure
```

## Descriptive summary

```{r}
#| label: tbl-blood-descriptive
#| tbl-cap: "Blood products during the first 182 days by randomized group"

descriptive_summary <- blood_data |>
  mutate(group = if_else(tx == 1, "ctDNA", "Usual care")) |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    patients_transfused = sum(n_blood_products > 0),
    erythrocyte_concentrates = sum(n_erythrocyte_concentrates),
    thrombocyte_concentrates = sum(n_thrombocyte_concentrates),
    blood_products = sum(n_blood_products),
    exposure_days = sum(exposure_days),
    .by = group
  ) |>
  mutate(n_excluded_zero_exposure = n_zero_exposure)

write_parquet(
  descriptive_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "descriptive-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

kable(descriptive_summary)
```

## Imputation of baseline covariates

```{r}
#| label: missing-covariates

blood_data |>
  summarise(across(
    c(hemoglobin, platelet_count, creatinine, ecog_group),
    \(x) sum(is.na(x))
  ))
```

## Spline knots

- `splines::ns()` spans the same space as the SAP's three-knot restricted cubic spline.

```{r}
#| label: spline-knots

spline_variables <- c("age", "hemoglobin", "platelet_count", "creatinine")

spline_knots <- blood_data |>
  select(all_of(spline_variables)) |>
  map(\(x) quantile(x, c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))

saveRDS(spline_knots, file.path(results_dir, "spline-knots.rds"))

spline_knots
```

```{r}
#| label: ns-call

ns_call <- function(variable) {
  knots <- spline_knots[[variable]]

  sprintf(
    "splines::ns(%s, knots = %s, Boundary.knots = c(%s, %s))",
    variable,
    knots[2],
    knots[1],
    knots[3]
  )
}

ns_call("hemoglobin")
```

## Imputation model

- Covariates predict each other through spline bases, as in the analysis model.

```{r}
#| label: imputation-data

# Column order sets the mice visit sequence; keep it.
imputation_data <- blood_data |>
  mutate(log_exposure = log(exposure_days)) |>
  select(
    tx,
    n_erythrocyte_concentrates,
    n_thrombocyte_concentrates,
    log_exposure,
    all_of(spline_variables),
    ecog_group
  )

# Append the basis columns (age_ns1, age_ns2, hemoglobin_ns1, ...) at the end.
for (variable in spline_variables) {
  basis <- eval(parse(text = ns_call(variable)), envir = imputation_data)

  imputation_data[[paste0(variable, "_ns1")]] <- basis[, 1]
  imputation_data[[paste0(variable, "_ns2")]] <- basis[, 2]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: imputation-methods

incomplete_labs <- c("hemoglobin", "platelet_count", "creatinine")

methods <- make.method(imputation_data)
methods[] <- ""
methods[incomplete_labs] <- "pmm"
methods["ecog_group"] <- "polr"

# Passive imputation keeps the basis columns in line with the imputed values.
for (variable in incomplete_labs) {
  for (column in 1:2) {
    methods[paste0(variable, "_ns", column)] <- sprintf(
      "~I(%s[, %d])",
      ns_call(variable),
      column
    )
  }
}

methods[methods != ""]
```

```{r}
#| label: imputation-predictors

basis_columns <- function(variables) {
  paste0(rep(variables, each = 2), "_ns", 1:2)
}

common_predictors <- c(
  "tx",
  "n_erythrocyte_concentrates",
  "n_thrombocyte_concentrates",
  "log_exposure"
)

predictors <- make.predictorMatrix(imputation_data)
predictors[] <- 0

for (variable in incomplete_labs) {
  other_splines <- setdiff(spline_variables, variable)

  predictors[
    variable,
    c(common_predictors, "ecog_group", basis_columns(other_splines))
  ] <- 1
}

predictors[
  "ecog_group",
  c(common_predictors, basis_columns(spline_variables))
] <- 1

predictors[c(incomplete_labs, "ecog_group"), colSums(predictors) > 0]
```

```{r}
#| label: impute-covariates

if (!file.exists(imputation_path)) {
  imputation <- mice(
    imputation_data,
    method = methods,
    predictorMatrix = predictors,
    m = config$imputation$m_supporting,
    maxit = config$imputation$maxit,
    donors = config$imputation$donors,
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 2400L,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  saveRDS(imputation, imputation_path, compress = "xz")
}

imputation <- readRDS(imputation_path)

c(m = imputation$m, iterations = imputation$iteration)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-imputation-traces
#| fig-cap: "MICE trace plots for the imputed baseline covariates"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7

plot_mice_traces(mice_chain_stats(imputation))
```

## Completed datasets

```{r}
#| label: completed-datasets

completed_datasets <- complete(imputation, action = "all") |>
  map(\(data) {
    data |>
      mutate(
        n_blood_products = n_erythrocyte_concentrates + n_thrombocyte_concentrates,
        exposure_days = exp(log_exposure),
        ecog_group = factor(ecog_group, ordered = FALSE)
      ) |>
      select(-log_exposure, -ends_with(c("_ns1", "_ns2")))
  })

saveRDS(completed_datasets, completed_path, compress = "xz")
```
